# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `.ai/conventions.md` for requests that may change software code, behavior, tests, technical configuration, schemas, dependencies, build or deployment configuration, or CC Flow itself. Read only relevant project context and reuse unchanged content already loaded.

For read-only questions, explanations, exploration, research, reports, summaries, status checks, or standalone document creation, do not create or update CC Flow records unless explicitly requested.

Routine Git integration, tagging/release, and deployment of an existing reviewed artifact through an established runbook stay outside CC Flow unless semantic code/configuration changes are required; normal permission and production-safety requirements still apply.

Light needs no task directory; Compact uses one task.md; Full alone uses separate stage records. Keep changes scoped, preserve compatibility unless the task explicitly changes it, run the repository's real checks, and update affected documentation.
